decisive_items: coagulative necrosis with frequent karyorrhexis and a lymphoplasmacytoid infiltrate
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because its label, Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease, is more specifically supported by the biopsy findings of coagulative necrosis and karyorrhexis, which are characteristic of this disease. R1, Castleman disease, is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, such as lymphoplasmacytoid infiltrate, but the presence of coagulative necrosis and karyorrhexis makes R3 a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: laboratory studies were all normal or negative, which makes Sarcoidosis less likely
Rosai-Dorfman disease has some supporting evidence, but it is not as strong as R3's support
